resources.string: For analysis: every 5 minutes reads the parameters from the chosen list and writes the changes to the Download folder. Up to 400 MB.
no access to the Download folder

The list is a text file in the Download folder with lines like Group.NAME=number (as in the catalog dump); lines starting with # are comments. Choose the file with the “Choose” button: the app reads it where it is and never copies it. The list can be changed only while recording is off. Every 5 minutes (and when the mode changes: parked, driving, charging) the app reads the parameters from the list and writes only what changed to a file. Write commands and command-like parameters are never read, even if they are in the list — they are shown as cancelled. The event recorder runs alongside. Read only: nothing in the car is changed. The fidscan-….txt files and the event recorder files are in the Download folder. No more than 400 MB is written in total, then recording stops by itself. If you switch the car off and on again, recording continues in a new file. Recording starts only if at least 5 GB is free, and stops if less space is left. To send: tap “Pack to zip and send” — the app puts all recording files into one archive and opens the share sheet.
